## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new setter should normalize keys before storing them: uppercase and mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved through the case-insensitive getter.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `get("ALPHA")` returns `None` instead of `1`. The setter stores the original key, while `get()` lowercases every lookup; the added round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. Store entries under `key.lower()` and add coverage for uppercase writes and overwrites using different casing. — Callers lose access to values written with uppercase or mixed-case keys, and differently cased writes fail to replace an existing value.
